svg.desc: A left-to-right funnel: a catalogue of millions to billions of items, retrieval with several cheap generators in about 10 ms, hundreds to thousands of candidates, a ranking model with rich features, business and diversity rules, and the 10 to 50 items shown and logged. Retrieval is judged by recall at K, ranking by NDCG.

svg.text: Each stage sees fewer items and can afford a richer model per item.
